what: In a list of large capital-letter lines, only the active line is fully opaque (1, the others .3). At both ends of that line, two vertical photos pop out from .5 scale and transparent to 1 over .3s, tilted at angles set per line (−11·15 / −15·11 / −14·15 / −11·12 …). The left photo pivots at its bottom right (110% 90%), and the right photo at its bottom left (−10% 90%). It moves to the next line every 4 seconds, and hovering a line stops it on that line, then resumes after 4 seconds once released

options.every: Interval to advance to the next line (seconds), default 4 — 0 means no auto-advance
options.angles: Two photo angles (degrees) per row, comma-separated, default -11,15,-15,11,-14,15,-11,12,-8,12,-11,15
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Line text — where to place your hand
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photos in the row (one or two — the first at the left edge, the second at the right edge)

use: Benefit One

from.where: recruit.js .rc-benefits — original recruiting ‹Benefits of working together› (h1 opacity-30 → 100 · photo scale-50 → 100 · rotate(--active-angle) · duration-300 · delayedCall(4))

note: Photo size and position are set by the user’s CSS (the part only uses transform·opacity). With reduced motion only the first line stays on
